mitten_pair_red_white.description: 同一对小号针织手套，暖红与象牙白横向宽条纹；左右手型明确相反，袖口为象牙白罗纹；质地柔软，无图案文字。
mitten_pair_red_white.states: 双只戴在手上→玄关摘下→右手套遗落木凳脚旁、左手套在藤篮→两只重聚并放稳藤篮。

basket_wicker.description: 浅蜂蜜色藤编椭圆收纳篮，圆润低矮、双侧小把手、编织纹理紧密。
basket_wicker.states: 固定在玄关门边地面，随后被推入入口木架下层；不瞬移。

bench_low_wood.description: 矮小的浅棕色实木换鞋凳，四条直木腿，简单无靠背。
bench_low_wood.states: 固定在玄关；右手套掉落并靠近靠内侧凳脚，在捡起前不移动。

scarf_small.description: 小围巾，柔和蓝绿色纯色针织，无流苏或图案。
scarf_small.states: 睡前叠好后放入玄关藤篮，之后一直在篮内。

slippers_blue.description: 皮皮室内穿的蓝布拖鞋，一双。
slippers_blue.states: 进门换鞋时在凳边，后续收在入口处，不出现在卧室床上。

flashlight.description: 小型圆柱手电筒，深灰蓝色，无字。
flashlight.states: 仅作“以前可能去找”的回忆情境道具，停在鞋柜上；门始终关闭。

entry_shelf.description: 玄关门边浅棕色木架，三层开放格。
entry_shelf.states: 篮子从门边地面被推到下层，随后留在原处。

carrot_plush.description: 一只橙色胡萝卜布偶，深绿叶冠，简洁柔软，不带脸部文字或附件。
carrot_plush.states: 开始靠在枕边，皮皮回床后抱在胸口，全片仅一只。

yellow_blanket.description: 平整的暖黄色布被，柔软有细布纹。
yellow_blanket.states: 卧室床上平整盖住皮皮身体，末尾状态不变。

pipi_identity.description: 暖灰毛小兔、圆脸、粉鼻、自然下垂长耳；日间背书包穿灰蓝背带裤和米色上衣，夜间星星睡帽与柔软睡衣。
pipi_identity.standard_reference: 03_素材与参数/角色参考图库/v4/初始化与转场评估_v001/角色原图/pipi_identity_v001.png
pipi_identity.states: 全天身份造型一致，日间出门为日常装，夜间居家与卧室沿用夜间装。

rongrong_identity.description: 浅棕绒毛小熊，圆耳、米色口鼻，外形按角色图库。
rongrong_identity.standard_reference: 03_素材与参数/角色参考图库/v4/初始化与转场评估_v001/角色原图/rongrong_identity_v001.png
rongrong_identity.states: 只在放学后院门口与皮皮一起堆雪球，之后离场。

shot_states.state_before: Opening winter entryway, symbolic preview; no character movement.
shot_states.action: 窗外静静落雪，室内玄关暖灯透出柔光；不出现角色和手套，作为独立片头第一幅。
shot_states.state_after: Establishes quiet winter-night setting.
shot_states.emotion: 无人物静物，冬夜柔和宁静。

shot_states.state_before: Symbolic opening only: two matching mittens on their own.
shot_states.action: 红白条纹针织小手套并排放在浅木桌上，左右手各一只，柔和雪光；片头独立意象，不出现角色。
shot_states.state_after: Foreshadows the story without changing plot state.
shot_states.emotion: 静物特写，温暖、轻巧。

shot_states.state_before: Independent teaser image: one mitten is alone; main story has not started.
shot_states.action: 皮皮戴深蓝星星睡帽，蹲在藤篮旁好奇地看一只红白手套；眼睛睁开、耳朵轻轻抬起，不显困倦。
shot_states.state_after: The question of its partner remains open.
shot_states.emotion: 好奇而不着急，身体微微前倾。

shot_states.state_before: Morning: Pipi wears the left and right mitten, daytime outfit and school bag.
shot_states.action: 皮皮穿灰蓝背带裤和米色上衣，背黄色小书包，正在把红白针织手套戴好；神情专注、期待出门。
shot_states.state_after: Pipi leaves toward school with both mittens.
shot_states.emotion: 清晨出门前，双手都戴手套。

shot_states.state_before: Pipi continues on the snowy path with both mittens on; no prop is lost.
shot_states.action: 皮皮戴着一双红白条纹手套、背黄色书包，沿积雪小路往学校走；冷空气、脚印和稀疏树影。
shot_states.state_after: Arrives home after school still wearing the pair.
shot_states.emotion: 步伐轻快，脸颊微红，目光朝前。

shot_states.state_before: Pipi and Rongrong play at the yard gate; both mittens still on.
shot_states.action: 皮皮与小熊绒绒在院门口一起滚一个小雪球；冬季日光柔和，雪球小而圆。
shot_states.state_after: Snowball play ends; Rongrong is no longer present in later scenes.
shot_states.emotion: 两位伙伴专注又开心，动作自然克制。

shot_states.state_before: At the entry, Pipi removes both mittens while changing into slippers; the right glove slips near the inner stool leg.
shot_states.action: 雪球游戏刚结束，皮皮进门前坐在玄关矮木凳上摘下红白手套；门已关上，雪地留在窗外。
shot_states.state_after: At bedtime, the left glove is in the basket; the right glove remains hidden beside the stool.
shot_states.emotion: 皮皮觉得手套不灵活，平静地把它们摘下。

shot_states.state_before: Night entryway; one left mitten in the basket, right mitten hidden by the stool; scarf not yet added.
shot_states.action: 皮皮穿柔软睡衣、戴星星帽，查看明天上学要穿的衣物；暖灯照着挂钩和收纳架。
shot_states.state_after: Pipi begins putting away tomorrow’s clothing.
shot_states.emotion: 从容地检查，目光落在衣物上。

shot_states.state_before: The same basket gains the folded teal scarf; exactly one left mitten remains inside.
shot_states.action: 皮皮把叠好的小围巾放进门边椭圆形藤编篮，低头注意到篮中东西；镜头略俯看。
shot_states.state_after: The right mitten is still missing.
shot_states.emotion: 动作轻柔，神情从平常转为疑惑。

shot_states.state_before: Close view: one left mitten and folded scarf in basket; no right glove.
shot_states.action: 藤编篮里只有一只左手红白条纹针织手套，旁边放着叠好的小围巾；右手套缺席。
shot_states.state_after: Pipi recognizes a mismatch.
shot_states.emotion: 安静的静物特写，手套不重复。

shot_states.state_before: Left glove remains in basket; right glove remains unseen at stool.
shot_states.action: 皮皮看着篮里那只左手套，眼睛略睁大，耳尖轻轻抬起；只表现一瞬惊讶，未伸手找。
shot_states.state_after: Pipi wonders where it went.
shot_states.emotion: 轻微惊讶、仍努力镇定。

shot_states.state_before: Remembered former reaction only; current right mitten still hidden, left glove still in basket.
shot_states.action: 皮皮在玄关原地转了半圈，眉眼有些焦急；用轻淡回忆感表现过去的习惯，不夸张。
shot_states.state_after: Pipi pauses before taking any action.
shot_states.emotion: 回忆中的不安，温和小幅度。

shot_states.state_before: Door remains closed; flashlight stays on the shoe cabinet; no one goes outdoors.
shot_states.action: 皮皮的爪子停在门把手旁，手电筒搁在鞋柜上，门保持关闭，窗外可见雪；没有跑到户外。
shot_states.state_after: Pipi chooses not to search in the snow yet.
shot_states.emotion: 犹豫但克制，注意到自己尚未开门。

shot_states.state_before: Pipi relaxes his shoulders under the warm lamp; basket unchanged.
shot_states.action: 皮皮把肩膀放松，双爪轻放腹前，停下来观察眼前的篮子和入口；表情变得平静。
shot_states.state_after: He starts a calm search.
shot_states.emotion: 情緒安定，目光专注。

shot_states.state_before: Pipi takes one slow breath; door stays closed; only the left glove is visible in basket.
shot_states.action: 皮皮站在暖灯下闭眼深吸一口气，门仍关着，手电筒留在鞋柜上。
shot_states.state_after: Pipi’s memory turns toward the afternoon entry.
shot_states.emotion: 身体由紧绷转松，呼吸平稳。

shot_states.state_before: Night Pipi looks toward the same stool while recalling the afternoon; no thought-bubble character duplication.
shot_states.action: 皮皮睁眼后望向矮木凳，脑海中回想傍晚进门；用柔淡的回忆色处理，画面仍是同一玄关布局。
shot_states.state_after: Memory shifts to the earlier shoe-changing moment.
shot_states.emotion: 思考而平静，目光落到换鞋凳。

shot_states.state_before: Flashback: daytime Pipi sits to change shoes; right glove slips from his knee toward the inner stool leg.
shot_states.action: 回忆中的皮皮坐在矮木凳上换下蓝布鞋；红白手套曾在膝盖附近，藤篮在门边、木凳位置固定。
shot_states.state_after: Right glove comes to rest beside the stool; it is not picked up.
shot_states.emotion: 专注回想当时动作，姿态自然。

shot_states.state_before: Present time: Pipi bends to look under the stool; left glove and scarf stay in the basket.
shot_states.action: 回到现在，皮皮蹲下探头查看矮木凳下方；同一藤篮仍在门边，门保持关闭。
shot_states.state_after: He notices the right glove.
shot_states.emotion: 眼神认真寻找，身体向前倾。

shot_states.state_before: Discovery: one right glove by the inner stool leg; one left glove in the basket.
shot_states.action: 皮皮刚看到木凳脚边阴影中的右手红白手套，脸上露出克制的惊喜；手套仍在地面、尚未捡起。
shot_states.state_after: No prop has moved yet.
shot_states.emotion: 明亮的发现瞬间，眼睛睁开、嘴角上扬。

shot_states.state_before: Close-up of the single right glove in the stool shadow; left glove remains elsewhere in basket.
shot_states.action: 近景：右手红白条纹手套安静靠着矮木凳的一只木脚，落在小小阴影里；皮皮的脸与前爪从上方进入视野。
shot_states.state_after: Pipi has found the missing glove.
shot_states.emotion: 手套清楚可辨，仍未被拿起。

shot_states.state_before: Pipi is pleased at the find; right glove remains on floor; left glove remains in basket.
shot_states.action: 从皮皮视线看，右手套依然靠着同一条木凳脚；皮皮蹲在旁边高兴地确认找到，不改变物件位置。
shot_states.state_after: He bends to retrieve it.
shot_states.emotion: 轻快欣喜，动作克制。

shot_states.state_before: Pipi picks up right glove; exactly one other mitten remains in the basket.
shot_states.action: 皮皮弯腰伸爪，将靠在凳脚旁的右手套轻轻捡起；地上不再留另一只手套。
shot_states.state_after: The right glove is in Pipi’s paws.
shot_states.emotion: 高兴、动作轻柔。

shot_states.state_before: Right glove in Pipi’s paws while he brushes off dust; left glove and scarf remain in basket.
shot_states.action: 皮皮用一只爪子轻轻掸掉右手套表面的一点细灰，另一只爪托住手套；藤篮仍在地面门边。
shot_states.state_after: The recovered glove is ready to be stored.
shot_states.emotion: 专注爱惜手套，轻轻微笑。

shot_states.state_before: Right glove is returned to the same basket beside the left glove; scarf remains.
shot_states.action: 皮皮把右手套放进同一个藤篮，原有左手套与小围巾仍在；两只红白手套并排但尚未细致摆正。
shot_states.state_after: Both mittens reunite in the basket.
shot_states.emotion: 安心、动作稳妥。

shot_states.state_before: Close view of the exact two mittens, one left and one right, thumbs oriented in opposite directions; scarf beside them.
shot_states.action: 篮中左手套与右手套并排，红白条纹一致；一只拇指朝左、一只朝右，掌心彼此相挨。
shot_states.state_after: The pair lies flat and close together.
shot_states.emotion: 温柔团聚感，不拟人化、不添加表情。

shot_states.state_before: Same pair with palms touching, scarf still in basket.
shot_states.action: 同一对红白针织手套的掌心挨着掌心，左右手型清楚相反；镜头稍近，篮中围巾仍在旁边。
shot_states.state_after: The reunion is complete.
shot_states.emotion: 安稳、整齐，细节可辨。

shot_states.state_before: Exactly two mittens and the same scarf sit tidy in the basket.
shot_states.action: 俯视藤篮：左、右手套完整成对地平放在叠好的围巾旁；不增加第三只手套。
shot_states.state_after: Basket is ready to be stored.
shot_states.emotion: 整齐、安顿妥当的静物。

shot_states.state_before: Pipi pushes the basket from the entry floor into the lower shelf; contents stay inside.
shot_states.action: 皮皮双爪把藤篮平稳推入门边木架的固定下层，篮子里的成对手套保持朝上可见。
shot_states.state_after: The basket reaches the shelf.
shot_states.emotion: 动作轻而稳，略带满意。

shot_states.state_before: Nighttime entryway; basket rests on the lower shelf with two mittens and folded scarf.
shot_states.action: 夜晚的皮皮看着已放稳的藤篮，想象明早只需顺手取出手套；画面仍保持夜景，不切换成真实次日。
shot_states.state_after: Pipi feels tomorrow will be easier; no morning transition occurs.
shot_states.emotion: 松一口气，神情轻松。

shot_states.state_before: Pipi leaves toward the bedroom; basket remains on entryway shelf.
shot_states.action: 皮皮转身离开玄关，藤篮留在木架下层，成对手套没有移动。
shot_states.state_after: The glove search is over.
shot_states.emotion: 轻松地迈步回卧室，门未打开。

shot_states.state_before: Bedroom doorway: Pipi returns with empty paws; single carrot plush remains by pillow.
shot_states.action: 皮皮从玄关回到自己的卧室，步子放松，深蓝星星睡帽保持不变。
shot_states.state_after: Pipi settles at bedside.
shot_states.emotion: 安心、步伐轻快。

shot_states.state_before: Pipi is in bed; both paws rest beneath the yellow blanket; carrot plush stays beside the pillow.
shot_states.action: 皮皮在小床上把两只爪子并排放进被窝，黄色被子平整盖住身体；橙色胡萝卜玩偶靠在枕边。
shot_states.state_after: He relaxes into bed.
shot_states.emotion: 舒服地松弛下来，眼神柔和。

shot_states.state_before: Pipi hugs the same carrot plush at his chest; one plush total.
shot_states.action: 皮皮把橙色胡萝卜玩偶抱在胸前，轻轻闭上眼睛；睡帽、枕头、黄色被子保持一致。
shot_states.state_after: His eyes close for sleep.
shot_states.emotion: 平静、满足，不显担心。

shot_states.setting: 卧室与门廊的连贯空间
shot_states.state_before: Bedroom only: Pipi sleeps with carrot plush; the entryway basket is not in the bedroom.
shot_states.action: 前景皮皮安睡并抱着一只胡萝卜玩偶；背景门边藤篮里可见同一对红白手套。
shot_states.state_after: All things are settled.
shot_states.emotion: 安稳温暖，不复制角色或道具。

shot_states.state_before: Pipi remains asleep in bed with the same carrot toy and yellow blanket.
shot_states.action: 皮皮安静地睡在小床上，胡萝卜玩偶靠着胸口，黄色被子平整；一盏小夜灯柔和发亮。
shot_states.state_after: The story’s reassurance continues over the sleeping scene.
shot_states.emotion: 安宁、安心的睡颜。

shot_states.state_before: Two paws remain tucked into the same blanket; carrot plush remains at chest.
shot_states.action: 两只小爪子并排收在黄色被子里，皮皮与胡萝卜玩偶在上方画面中安睡。
shot_states.state_after: The bedtime invitation ends.
shot_states.emotion: 柔和、放松，动作完成。

shot_states.state_before: Final winter-night bedroom; Pipi and single plush asleep; no object changes.
shot_states.action: 卧室暖灯渐暗，窗外安静飘雪，屋内床上皮皮已睡着；保持绘本水彩留白。
shot_states.state_after: Quiet end card image, followed by the planned tail.
shot_states.emotion: 静谧结束画面。

textual_review: passed: detailed sequential review confirmed school-to-entry transition, afternoon memory, glove loss and discovery, basket contents, scarf retention and movement to the shelf, then separate bedroom with carrot plush. Door stays closed; Rongrong leaves after yard scene.

checks: no glove appears in the basket until recovered right glove is returned
exactly one left mitten remains during search; right mitten appears under stool before pickup
two mitten orientations and scarf retained after reunion
basket remains on entry shelf after Pipi leaves
carrot plush and yellow blanket only appear in bedroom
Pipi open attentive expression during searching/action shots; closed eyes only for breathing or bedtime
